description: Create a Grok Imagine task on RunAPI (extend video). Returns a task id, status, and output URLs.

callback_url.description: Webhook URL for terminal Task delivery. Declared type: string.

extension_duration_seconds.description: Extension duration in seconds. Declared type: integer. Known values: 6, 10.

prompt.description: Video continuation prompt. Declared type: string.

source_task_id.description: Completed prior Grok Imagine video Task ID. Declared type: string.

start_seconds.description: Source video position in seconds where extension begins. Declared type: integer.

wait.description: Poll until the task reaches a terminal status.

name: extend_video
